mapper.select: select telemetry_code from processed_telemetry_filter_selection where task_id = #{taskId} and device_satellite_id = #{deviceSatelliteId} and is_deleted = 0

select selection.task_id, selection.device_satellite_id, selection.telemetry_code, rule_config.telemetry_name from processed_telemetry_filter_selection selection inner join device_satellite device on device.id = selection.device_satellite_id and device.task_id = selection.task_id and device.is_deleted = 0 inner join telemetry_parse_rule_config rule_config on rule_config.task_id = selection.task_id and rule_config.device_satellite_id = selection.device_satellite_id and rule_config.telemetry_code = selection.telemetry_code and rule_config.is_deleted = 0 where selection.task_id = #{taskId} and selection.is_deleted = 0 order by selection.device_satellite_id, selection.telemetry_code
mapper.insert: insert into processed_telemetry_filter_selection (task_id, device_satellite_id, telemetry_code, is_deleted) values (#{taskId}, #{deviceSatelliteId}, #{telemetryCode}, #{deleted}) on conflict (task_id, device_satellite_id, telemetry_code) do update set is_deleted = excluded.is_deleted, update_time = current_timestamp
mapper.update: update processed_telemetry_filter_selection selection set is_deleted = 1, update_time = current_timestamp where selection.task_id = #{taskId} and selection.is_deleted = 0 and selection.device_satellite_id in ( select id from device_satellite where task_id = #{taskId} and type = #{type} ) and not exists ( select 1 from telemetry_parse_rule_config rule_config where rule_config.task_id = selection.task_id and rule_config.device_satellite_id = selection.device_satellite_id and rule_config.telemetry_code = selection.telemetry_code and rule_config.is_deleted = 0 )
